items.t: Automatic transmission harsh shifts, slipping or failure
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a rebuilt or used unit
items.note: A pressure control solenoid or valve body repair costs much less if that is the only fault.

items.t: All-wheel-drive transfer case can break and spray fluid (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Ask a Ford dealer with your VIN whether the recall was completed.

items.t: Ignition switch can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Ask a Ford dealer with your VIN whether the recall was completed.

items.t: Accelerator cable can fray and stick (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Ask a Ford dealer with your VIN whether the recall was completed.

items.t: Aluminum wheels crack at the spokes
items.job: Replace a cracked wheel (used or aftermarket, each)
items.note: Price is per wheel; many owners replace all four.

items.t: Front wheel bearing failure
items.job: Replace front wheel bearings and seal (one side)
items.note: Cost rises sharply if the spindle, rotor or caliper was damaged.

items.t: Rear axle bearing, seal or shaft failure
items.job: Replace rear axle bearing and seal (one side)

items.t: Warped front rotors and pulsing brakes
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Brakes fade or lose power after heavy use
items.job: Replace front calipers and flush brake fluid

items.t: Rear ABS warning light comes on
items.job: Diagnose rear ABS and replace speed sensor
items.note: A failed rear ABS valve costs more.

items.t: Rear brake drums stick or adjusters seize
items.job: Replace rear brake shoes, drums and hardware

items.t: Oil leaks from the rear main seal and oil pan
items.job: Replace oil pan gasket
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $549–$730 for the pan gasket. A rear main seal needs the transmission removed.

items.t: Knocking noise from the 4.0L engine
items.job: Diagnose engine noise and check oil pressure
items.note: A real bearing failure needs an engine rebuild or replacement.

items.t: Thumping coolant hose and swinging temperature gauge
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant

items.t: Long crank or stalling after the van sits
items.job: Clean or replace idle air control valve

items.t: Check engine light with misfire codes
items.job: Reprogram computer or replace plugs and wires

items.t: Heater core leaks
items.job: Replace heater core

items.t: Air switches to the defroster when accelerating
items.job: Repair vacuum line or reservoir for climate controls

items.t: A/C compressor fails
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, drier and recharge

items.t: Blower motor chirps or squeaks
items.job: Replace blower motor

items.t: Front axle oil leaks from the vent (AWD)
items.job: Reroute front axle vent and refill fluid

items.t: Power steering pump leaks or loses assist
items.job: Replace power steering pump

items.t: Rapping or clanging noise when steering
items.job: Service or replace steering shaft/linkage part

items.t: Driver door latch may not hold (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Ask a Ford dealer with your VIN whether the recall was completed.

items.t: Wrong rear tire pressure on door label (recall)
items.job: Free dealer recall repair
items.note: Ask a Ford dealer with your VIN whether the recall was completed.

items.t: Shifter won't come out of Park or interlock acts up
items.job: Replace brake light switch or bulb

items.t: Sliding door won't latch or close properly
items.job: Adjust or replace sliding door latch

items.t: Battery drains while parked
items.job: Find parasitic draw and repair circuit

items.t: Buzzing or rattling from the exhaust
items.job: Secure or replace exhaust heat shield
